verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a billing platform that ships Paddle.js and server SDKs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry opt-out, a usage-tracking control, or any data-collection setting for the product, its SDKs, or its MCP servers. Community comments about Paddle's access to customer emails concern merchant data handling, not a telemetry opt-out, so they don't count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
